purpose: Requirements for the dependency-free agent-review backend, which runs reviews via a read-only custom Agent reviewer, one Agent per round, with availability checks and no persistence.
summary: Background: default review should work without external tools, message DBs, or resident sessions
Scope: availability check, read-only reviewer Agent, retains_context declared false
Out of scope: launching reviewer, fixing targets, session continuation, history, human intervention, auto fallback
FNC-1601: reviewer is read-only; forbidden writes, git mutations, external writes; findings only via a dedicated script
FNC-1602: a fresh reviewer Agent per round, no implicit context inheritance
FNC-1604: side-effect-free availability check of the reviewer definition, read-only constraints, scripts and documents
FNC-1606: no review history persisted; no resuming under the same review_id
NFR: non-persistence, no external dependencies, fail closed on unverifiable conditions
Acceptance criteria: distinct Agents per round, tool restrictions, per-condition unavailability reasons, no leftover resources
tasks: Implementing or modifying the agent-review backend
Designing the reviewer custom Agent and its tool constraints
Reviewing review backend requirements and design documents
Writing tests for review backend acceptance criteria
Integrating a review backend with the review body
title: REQ-016 agent-review バックエンド
